evidence: We developed RNA–DNA Proximity Proteomics (RDProx) that enables mapping of the R-loop-proximal proteome using the fusion protein of the hybrid-binding domain (HBD) of RNaseH1 and an engineered variant of ascorbate peroxidase (APEX2).
As a negative control, we employed a construct harboring three point mutations in the HBD (HBD-WKK) that led to a loss of affinity towards RNA–DNA hybrids
Stable isotope labeling with amino acids in cell culture (SILAC) was used to distinguish proteins that are proximal to the wild-type HBD compared to the WKK mutant
